primary_question: Does append_rename(nonempty_directory) preserve descendants, and does append_delete(nonempty_directory) avoid committing a non-equivalent namespace?
prediction: The source-level delta op implementation edits only a single directory row. A nonempty directory rename will leave old-prefix descendants and move only the directory row; nonempty directory deletion will remove only its row. Both may commit a namespace that no longer matches a real atomic POSIX operation.
